regionRule: Death on a road leg -> the region whose 'roads' list holds that leg (unordered). Death on the Westmark-Sarn's Rest travel or the final run -> the region holding gatePlace (today 'westmark'). Sea openings never kill (they spend no hours).
pick: random text from the region; never the same text twice in a row
title: Dry
lead: The skins are empty. The sand is not.

regions.name: the Westmark ranges
texts: Kethrans dragging molt down the scree found you face-down by your beasts. They kept the load for their trouble, took half your purse, and hauled you to Kharûn on a shed.
A Westmark wrangler saw the beasts standing with no one leading them. Half your scrubstone paid for the ride to Kharûn. The packs did not come with you.
A Kharûn caravan bound home turned you over with a boot, then threw you across a pack frame. Salvage is salvage. Half your purse went to the drover.

regions.name: the Draven highlands
texts: Fungus cutters out of the Draven caves found you in the frost-shade, lips cracked. They kept what you carried, took half your coin, and walked you down to Kharûn.
Ishka traders bound for Highmark found you by the track. They lifted you onto a pack frame and left you at Kharûn's gate, without your packs and lighter by half a purse.

regions.name: the Zamath coast
texts: Zamath salt-pan workers pulled you out of the glare and argued over you a while. The load went to them, half your scrubstone to the haulers' fee, and you to Kharûn.
A Kaleth clerk logged you as found goods. Your packs were sold to cover the cost, half your purse with them, and a caravan dropped you at Kharûn with a receipt.

regions.name: the southern shore and salt flats
texts: Sorel salt-cutters found you white with dust among the cones. They kept the load as payment and half your coin as fee, and sent you north to Kharûn on a salt run.
Hulv hunters out of Ghûl followed your beasts back to you. You woke on a sinew litter, packs gone and purse halved, with Kharûn's spires ahead.
A shore crew on the Ghorath road found you under your own beast's shadow. What you carried paid them. Half your scrubstone paid the road to Kharûn.

regions.name: the eastern dunes and the oasis road
texts: Moraq shell-gatherers working the dunes dug you out of a drift. Water is dear in Moraq. Your load and half your purse paid for theirs, and for the road to Kharûn.
A Veythar patrol found you on the mountain road and asked no questions. They kept the packs, took half your scrubstone, and left you at Kharûn's gate.
A Brineford drover found the beasts first and you second. The load was salvage. Half your coin bought you a place on a pack frame home to Kharûn.

regions.name: the Torvern foothills and the eastern ridges
texts: Torvern wranglers hauling with pincer beasts found you where the kelkris had. They kept your load, took half your coin, and carried you to Kharûn lashed among the bundles.
A Ridgewatch post rider found you in the rocks with your beasts lying down. Your packs went for salvage, half your purse for the fee, and you went home to Kharûn.
Ashar stone-cutters carried you down off the spur. They kept what you carried and half what you held, and saw you to Kharûn.
